prompts: Based on scripts/sprite-puppet/strip-rigs/grenadier.json and the templates in scripts/sprite-puppet/strip-prompts/. One conversation drew the master; the damage sheet, the attack strip, the hit strip and the defeat strip were each drawn from the master as one prompt per image. The throw and defeat frames keep the grenade in the figure's hand (no detached projectile), the cap is specified as dull maroon so it does not take the team tint, and the hit and defeat prompts ask for no glow or halo. The prompts ChatGPT actually ran were adapted from the templates and were not captured verbatim.
